overview.description: The Matthews Pacific Tiger Active ETF (ASIA) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in total market equity. The fund is an actively managed fund that seeks long-term capital appreciation by investing in companies located in Asia, excluding Japan. The fund manager selects stocks based on strong fundamentals. ASIA was launched on Sep 22, 2023 and is issued by Matthews.
